HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. NIGHT west road: packed earth, black pines, one pale moon-break. EXTREME FORESHORTENING — muzzles and paws coming at the lens. ONE DEVICE: the road as a vanishing strip. TWO enormous bloodhounds (Cheollidongi and Mallidongi — FACE AND BODY from the attached bloodhounds board) mid-lunge, mouths open, spit and dust, eyes lit by the one hard key. A few salted buckwheat cakes scattered in the foreground dirt as tiny bright shapes. Crushed blacks, #C30000 only as specular on wet gums and a torn scrap of cloth — real light, never a glow. Manga action foreshortening, bold dry-brush speed lines along the motion, no text, no sound-effect lettering. No watermark.
